name: facemirror-3d
description: Webcam-driven 2.5D photo face puppet as the main app, with a separate 3D face studio.

scripts.test: npm run test:3d && npm run test:puppet
scripts.test:puppet: node tools/build.mjs --check && node tools/verify.mjs && node tools/harness.mjs
scripts.check: for f in src/*.js src/puppet/*.js tools/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node tools/build.mjs --check
scripts.check:3d: for f in src/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
